es.tagline: FRODO gobierna los datos, SAM los hace utilizables.
es.map_body: FRODO coordina cuatro piezas por formato (reader, sets, residuals, stats) mediante registros. SAM aporta cálculo y utilidades: Gardener ensambla tensores, Backpack resuelve ficheros y mallas (incluida la malla HORSES3D), Weapons/DifferentialOperators implementan ordenación, derivación e interpolación, y DictVisualizer/HDF5reader inspeccionan resultados.
es.matrix_note: NUMPYFILE está obsoleto y no tiene flujo propio. HORSES3D tiene sets/stats pendientes: su flujo se documenta como parcial.
es.ref_nodoc: Contrato heredado: este método delega o replica la pieza base; ver ficha de la clase base.
es.flows_note: Cada flujo muestra solo salidas obtenidas de verdad al re-ejecutar. El flujo HORSES3D es parcial.

en.tagline: FRODO rules the data, SAM makes it usable.
en.map_body: FRODO coordinates four per-format pieces (reader, sets, residuals, stats) through registries. SAM provides computation and utilities: Gardener assembles tensors, Backpack resolves files and meshes (including the HORSES3D mesh), Weapons/DifferentialOperators implement sorting, differentiation and interpolation, and DictVisualizer/HDF5reader inspect results.
en.matrix_note: NUMPYFILE is obsolete and has no flow of its own. HORSES3D sets/stats are pending: its flow is documented as partial.
en.ref_nodoc: Inherited contract: this method delegates to or mirrors the base piece; see the base-class card.
en.flows_note: Each flow shows only outputs truly obtained by re-running. The HORSES3D flow is partial.
